No reviewed TREC 2025 team demonstrated a hand-authored semantic-demand schema
for routing. The direct precedent is to retrieve fine-grained historical
query-response evidence, estimate response quality or preference, aggregate to
candidate IDs, and learn the scoring function when supervision is reliable.

Relation and answer-contract fields can remain human audit labels for a small
blinded validity study. They should not become a full ranking representation
until they reject wrong-relation neighbors and improve candidate discrimination
beyond raw dense similarity.

The canonical report is the audited deep dive for team-level method details,
source links, and the boundary between verified precedent and proposed work.
